name: Highlight reveal
what: An editorial page: a kicker, a serif headline whose key words get a highlighter sweep word after word, the text rising in under it and a row of three numbers.

learned_from.what: the yellow sweep behind the headline, the paragraphs building in, the numbers row

motion: words rise 16 f, 2 f apart; the marker sweeps 8 f a word; text lines 16 f, 8 f apart; the page drifts closer
